Trips per month come from the 2026 trip log: haulage and flat trucks (treated as one), including 3rd-party trucks. Closed-body/canter and Hiab trips are excluded.
Trucks rotate on their routes through the month: a 6-day round trip gives 4 trips per truck per month (weekly), an 8-day round trip gives 3, a 4-day round trip gives 6.
The second total row shares trucks across clients (a truck that finishes one client’s work takes another’s), so it is the smallest fleet that covers the month on average.
Loading/offloading waits beyond your turnaround days are not included; busy weeks inside a month may need more trucks than the monthly average shows.

Lagos pickup points use the Lagos loading bay, Ibadan depots the Ibadan bay; nearby towns (Ilesa, Akure, Ijebu Ode, Ota, Agbara, Ogere) use the nearest bay; returns toward Lagos/Ibadan use your table in reverse.
76 trips (5.3%) have no route in your table — mostly NBL depot-to-depot moves (NGB4/NGB5/NGB8, Ama, Kudenda). They use the default days until you add the route or type an override.
